title: Pegasus has Landed
overview: Gingka saves Kenta and is challenged to an uneven battle.

title: Leone's Roar!
overview: Madoka fights Kyoya with a broken bey Pegasus; Kyoya receives a strange visitor, who makes an enticing offer.

title: The Wolf's Ambition!
overview: Kenta challenges Gingka; Kyoya loses a battle and must leave with his opponent to train.

title: Charge! Bull Power
overview: Doji has a gift for Benkei, who later battles Gingka.

title: Vengeful Gasher
overview: Gingka is forced to battle a crab-obsessed villain who has kidnapped Madoka.

title: Aquario's Challenge
overview: Kenta poses as Gingka for a fight with Hikaru.

title: It's Our Special Move! Saggitario
overview: Benkei mentors Kenta, who wants a rematch with Hikaru; Madoka helps Kenta develop a special move.

title: Merci's Dangerous Trap
overview: Kyoya must prove himself during a challenge set up by Doji; Gingka thinks he's on a game show, but he's really being monitored by a computer.

title: Leone's Counterattack
overview: Kyoya battles Benkei; Gingka challenges Hikaru.

title: Heated Battle! Gingka Versus Kyoya
overview: Gingka battles Kyoya, who creates a tornado that rips through the city.

title: Chase the Wolf
overview: Gingka hunts for Doji at the Dark Nebula headquarters.

title: Infiltrate the Dark Nebula's Castle
overview: Merci sets traps for the gang inside the castle; Doji invites Gingka to join forces with him.

title: L-Drago Awakens!
overview: Gingka battles an old nemesis who uses Gingka's anger to fuel a forbidden bey.

title: Memories of Ryo
overview: Gingka's motivation for defeating Ryuga is revealed through a flashback focusing on his father.

title: Mysterious Hyoma
overview: The gang go after Gingka, who has decided to go home. The journey is perilous, and the group encounter a strange traveler along the way.

title: The Magnificent Aries
overview: Hyoma leads the gang to Gingka, but Kyoya is suspicious of Hyoma's intentions.

title: The Silver Pegasus
overview: Gingka searches for a scroll that could mean more power for Pegasus.

title: The Green Hades
overview: Gingka battles Hyoma---whom he's never been able to defeat---and uses his new power.

title: Conquer the Tag-Team Battle
overview: Benkei and Kenta team up for a tournament after learning to swap parts of their beys, which increases their power.

title: Begin! The Survival Battle!
overview: Gingka and friends enter the Survival Battle contest, in which the winner receives one wish. Meanwhile, Ryuga goes to a remote area and meets a powerful opponent.

title: Warriors on A Deserted Island
overview: Only eight competitors remain in The Survival Battle.

title: The Fearsome Libra
overview: In the jaw-dropping finale of The Survival Battle, everyone is surprised by who emerges victorious.

title: The Road to the Battle Bladers
overview: As the winner of the Endurance Battle, Yu is granted his wish: to have the biggest Beyblade competition in the world.

title: The Beautiful Eagle
overview: Battles heat up as the Bladers earn points for entry into the Battle Bladers competition. Gingka meets a new rival, Tsubasa, who tests his strength.

title: The Sniper Capricorn
overview: Kyoya comes across a calculating opponent Tobio, aka Captain Capri, with an erratic playing style that puts Kyoya's skills to the test.

title: Tsubasa Flies Into The Dark
overview: Tsubasa's skills catch the eye of Doji's Dark Nebula Organization.

title: Intruders In The Challenge Match
overview: The competition to make it into Battle Bladers heats up with Yu battling Hyoma and Tsubasa battling Kenta.

title: Dark Gasher's Big, Crabby-Crabby Organization
overview: As everyone gears up for Battle Bladers, the crab-obsessed Tetsuya is up to his usual tricks.

title: Kenta and Sora
overview: Kenta befriends a new blader, Sora, who has amazing power but lacks control.

title: The Bewitching Pisces
overview: Gingka is pushed to the limits when he enters an important challenge match and faces a self-proclaimed sorcerer named Ryutaro.

title: The Twin Gemios
overview: Four battles are underway in four different stadiums as the competition to make it into Battle Bladers heats up.

title: The Stormy Battle Royale
overview: In an exciting challenge match for Battle Bladers, six bladers are pitted against each other at the same time.

title: The Oath of the Phoenix
overview: When Phoenix saves Gingka's Bey Pointer from Tetsuya's claws, Gingka puts everything on the line in a battle with Phoenix.

title: Shine, Virgo!
overview: Gingka has to create a new special move when battling a new opponent Teru, who is a former dancer.

title: L-Drago, on the Move
overview: When Tsubasa is caught sneaking into the Dark Nebula, he must battle his way through Dark Nebula Bladers to earn his freedom.

title: Broken Wings
overview: Tsubasa is almost defeated by Ryuga in an intense battle until Phoenix comes to the rescue. Gingka fights Tobio in a stadium of moving walls.

title: Rock Scorpio's Deadly Poison
overview: When a gang led by Busujima takes over their stadium, Kenta and Sora have to battle hard to reclaim what is theirs.

title: Run, Gingka!
overview: Gingka must decide between a last opportunity to earn points and defending his friends against Tsubasa.

title: Clash! The Fireblaze vs The Pegasus
overview: Phoenix appears and challenges Tsubasa and Gingka to a battle. Tsubasa's true loyalties are revealed.

title: GO! Battle Bladers!
overview: With Doji in charge of the tournament, Battle Bladers begins and the gang pitted against tough opponents.

title: The Serpent's Terror
overview: In the opening matches, Hyoma goes up against a new Dark Nebula Blader, Reiji. Ryuga battles Hikaru.

title: The Dragon's Punishment
overview: The gang vows to avenge Hikaru's loss in the next round of battles. Yu battles Reiji to prove his worth to Dark Nebula.

title: The Deck is Stacked
overview: In the second round of Battle Bladers, Doji is up to his usual tricks. Benkei faces Kyoya and Gingka takes on Ryutaro.

title: Entrusted Emotions
overview: Kenta, determined to win for Yu and all true Bladers, takes on Reiji in the next round of the tournament.

title: Eagle Counterattacks
overview: Tsubasa fights his most difficult battle, against Ryuga and his Bey Lightning L-Drago.

title: Libra Disappears
overview: Gingka takes on Reiji in the semi-finals. Hyoma and Kenta go after Yu when he is kidnapped by Doji.

title: Bonds of Steel
overview: Phoenix arrives in the nick of time to help Kenta and Hyoma. Gingka's battle with Reiji at Battle Bladers heats up.

title: The Truth about Light and Darkness
overview: The Phoenix's shocking true identity is revealed. Ryuga betrays Doji.

title: Fierce Battle! Lion VS Dragon
overview: Kyoya must face Ryuga in the semi-finals at Battle Bladers. The winner will go on to face Gingka in the final match.

title: The Furious Final Battle!
overview: The epic final match of Battle Bladers begins with more than just victory on the line.

title: Blader's Spirit
overview: The Battle Bladers final match continues, and Gingka must summon all of his strength if he is to win and save the future of Beyblade.
